title: Outline feature properties, version 3
description: Properties every feature in outlines/<record-id>.geojson carries; $defs.collection is the file's own members. Geometry is WGS84 (EPSG:4326). A feature is one wellbore (Point), one survey or field (Polygon or MultiPolygon) or one line (LineString). Version 2: a derived feature (approximate: false) carries feature_id and the name of its input; the collection carries each input's identity once and the licence once (per feature only where it differs within a file). Version 3: a feature from a register whose rule names period_fields carries the dates the service states for it, raw and normalised, and the collection names those fields per input. Every version-1 placeholder and every version-2 file still validates.

approximate.description: true when the geometry is a placeholder (centroid, hand-drawn box) and not derived from the data; the map draws it differently and L3 requires false

source.description: How the geometry was derived: the extractor and the input name of its rule in src/osd/outlines/rules.yaml, or 'hand placed from publisher map' for a placeholder

publisher_id.description: The publisher's own identifier for the wellbore or survey

licence.description: The record's licence when it differs within a file; otherwise the collection's licence applies (OSD-D13)

simplified_m.description: Douglas-Peucker tolerance in metres applied to a derived polygon's rings (OSD-D16); absent on points and placeholders

input.description: The name of the record input the geometry was derived from: a key of the collection's inputs

rings_dropped.description: Rings of a derived polygon dropped because their area was below simplified_m squared (OSD-D16)

osd:period_start_raw.description: The feature's start as the publisher's service states it, verbatim (the input's period_fields.start)

osd:period_end_raw.description: The feature's end as the publisher's service states it, verbatim (the input's period_fields.end)

osd:period_start.description: osd:period_start_raw as an RFC 3339 UTC instant (a date: its first second; a timestamp without zone: read as UTC); absent when the raw value is a placeholder of the rule or not in its period_format

osd:period_end.description: osd:period_end_raw as an RFC 3339 UTC instant (a date: its last second); absent as for osd:period_start

collection.description: Members of the FeatureCollection beside type and features

licence.description: The licence of the record the features were derived from (OSD-D13)

sha256.description: sha256 of the input's SHA256SUMS (one sha256sum line per fetched part, in fetch order)

period_fields.description: The service properties the features' osd:period_start_raw and osd:period_end_raw were read from (src/osd/outlines/rules.yaml)

unplaced.description: feature_ids the publisher lists without a position: not drawn
